description: Navigable Waters as defined in the Water Environment (Abstractions and associated Impoundments) Act 2022 is a dataset listed in Ireland national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Waterways Ireland. Data set provided by Waterways Ireland which shows navigable waterways as defined in the Water Environment Act 2022. Coverage: Ireland. The portal files it under the publisher Waterways Ireland. Its tags are canal, canal waterbodies, canal waterbody, canal wfd waterbody, environment. It offers 3 resource(s) in HTML. The portal shows 2026-09-28 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support inland waterway and lock studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ie-portal.
